verdicts.reason: Both break the design the same way. The background panels, frame and pattern are scattered as separate pieces. The photos shrink to tiny thumbnails cropped inside the peach and pattern blocks, with empty photo frames below them. The orange frame stands empty, and the divider flourishes float loose in the strip. A at least keeps 'Cascadia RESTAURANT' together as one lockup, while B splits 'Cascadia' and 'RESTAURANT' far apart, which further damages the brand.
